Also allows for a weapon or shield to be held in the off-hand while a Staff is equipped.

@ext:This ability shares a cooldown with other interrupts.:ext@

per_rank_text: Performs a feint, causing no damage but lowering your threat by a large amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you. In addition, reduces the damage you take from area of effect attacks by 20% for 6 sec.

Healing Wave: Heals the target again for 30% of the original amount healed after 1 second.
